@Generated public final class CollectBlocksTaskProgressDetail extends com.google.protobuf.GeneratedMessage implements CollectBlocksTaskProgressDetailOrBuilder
Live diagnostics for a running block collection task. This is packed into
BotTaskProgress.detail so SDK clients can explain which blocks and approach
positions the server is currently considering without changing task
execution.
